title: Governance evidence schema backfill: zeroing 31 historical check-evidence / check-review strict failures
goal: scripts/harness/check-evidence.mjs --root . --strict and scripts/harness/check-review.mjs --root . --strict both exited 1 on this tree and every error belonged to a historical round, not to current work: 7 commands.json files missing linkage or knownGaps (or carrying runtimeSensitive/runtimeGap as arrays instead of boolean/string) and 24 review.md files that either had no ## Machine Readable JSON block (22), referenced a planRefs path the round itself archived and deleted (1), or used structuralReview.checks values outside the enum (1). The repair is structural only. No historical command status, verdict or gap judgement was rewritten: every backfilled string restates text already present in that same round's review.md, summary.md or commands.json, original array values are preserved under *Notes keys where a type had to collapse, and the 22 review.md edits are pure appends. Root cause is recorded as FR-016: neither strict checker is referenced by any workflow, so a schema requirement added after a round silently rotted that round's artifacts with no failing signal at the time. Wiring them into .github/workflows/quality.yml is a gate-policy change and is left to the maintainer rather than done here. The round also restores 5 generated files that had lost their DO-NOT-EDIT marker (a blocking check:generated failure) and one gofmt violation found while investigating.
findings: G-02 (closed): the governance chain was red before this round for reasons owned by no current task — 31 strict errors across historical artifacts. All 31 are now 0 errors / exit 0, measured, not asserted.

FR-016 (open): check-evidence --strict and check-review --strict validate the evidence contract but are absent from .github/workflows/quality.yml, so schema additions retroactively invalidate older artifacts. Recorded as registry-only; the gate change needs the maintainer.

F-11 (fixed by restore): 5 generated files (backend/modules/business/generated_registry.go, backend/modules/system/iam/menu/generated_component_registry.go, frontend/src/modules/generated/business.ts, frontend/src/modules/generated/system.ts, frontend/src/core/router/generatedComponentRegistry.ts) had lost the 'Code generated by pantheon low-code generator. DO NOT EDIT.' marker in the working tree. Their mtimes (08:38) predate this session's edits (12:00+), HEAD carries the marker and the consistency test passes there, so the actor is undetermined and is stated as such rather than guessed. The diff was archived to frontend/.tmp/f11-regression.diff before git restore.
F-12 (fixed): backend/internal/middleware/tenant_platform_scope_test.go failed gofmt; gofmt -w applied, gofmt -l . is now clean and go vet ./... exits 0.

implementationNotes: The Machine Readable extraction regex is /## Machine Readable\s+```json\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*```/m, so only whitespace may sit between the heading and the fence. The first backfill put a '>' note there and all 22 files still failed with 'missing ## Machine Readable JSON block'; the note now trails the block.

linkage values are derived from the evidence directory basename, and every path in linkage and planRefs must exist on disk. Five historical rounds have no task packet, so planRefs falls back to that round's .harness/tasks/<id>/manifest.json.

verdict is the machine restatement of the prose, never a new judgement: blocked is used only for 2026-10-07-release-closeout, whose text says the closeout is in-progress until the candidate SHA is pushed and hosted checks and merges complete. 2026-10-21-acceptance-remediation records an explicit withdrawn claim ('61 packages ok' retracted) and the backfill keeps that honesty rather than promoting it to approved.

Backfill was applied by replayable scripts kept under the gitignored frontend/.tmp/ (gov-fix-evidence.mjs, gov-fix-reviews.mjs) so the edits are reproducible and reviewable rather than hand-typed 31 times.

F-11's actor is unknown. Stating 'the generator produced it' would be a guess: HEAD is clean, the consistency test passes there, and the working-tree mtimes precede this session's edits. The honest record is: observed corruption, archived diff, restored from HEAD, gates re-greened.
